questions.label: Vendors
questions.ask: Which outside companies store or process your customers' personal data?
questions.codebase: SDK imports and API clients actually called at runtime, env variable names (STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, RESEND_API_KEY), deployment config. A package in package.json that is never called is not a vendor.

questions.label: What each vendor does
questions.ask: For each vendor, what does it do for you and which personal data does it get?
questions.example: Stripe: payments, gets name, email and billing details
questions.codebase: Call sites for each vendor SDK, showing which fields are sent.

questions.label: Vendor regions
questions.ask: Where does each vendor process the data?
questions.codebase: Region settings in vendor config (Supabase project region, Vercel function region, AWS region).

questions.label: Subprocessor page
questions.ask: Where will the subprocessor list be published?
questions.fills: DPA cover: List of Subprocessors URL
questions.codebase: Existing routes named subprocessors or legal.

questions.label: Notice of new vendors
questions.ask: How much notice will customers get before you add a new subprocessor?
options: 30 days by email and on the page
14 days by email and on the page
questions.fills: Subprocessor page introduction; must match DPA Section 4 notice

questions.label: Objections
questions.ask: What can a customer do if they object to a new subprocessor?
options: Object in writing; if unresolved, terminate and get a pro-rated refund
Object in writing; we work together on an alternative
questions.fills: Subprocessor page introduction; must match DPA Section 4
